title: Sample-efficient Personalization of Large Language Model Alignment with Multidimensional User Preference Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.22210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. Although they are effective, these methods quantify uncertainty from the perspective of the LLM, which may differ from the uncertainty perceived by the user: a pair can appear highly uncertain to the LLM even when past comparisons from the user already imply a clear ordering. translated_title: 基于多维用户偏好数据的大语言模型对齐的样本高效个性化
translated_abstract: 偏好对齐已成为使大语言模型（LLM）与人类价值观和期望行为保持一致的核心工具，其在线变体通过反复生成新的回复并利用人类反馈进行标注，能够进一步提升模型超越静态数据所能提供的能力。然而，昂贵且耗时的标注限制了其可扩展性，使得样本效率变得至关重要。现有方法通常通过扩大回复空间的覆盖范围、或选择不确定性最高的样本对进行比较来提升样本效率。尽管这些方法行之有效，但它们是从LLM自身的视角来量化不确定性，而这可能与用户所感知的不确定性不同：即使过去的用户比较已经隐含了明确的偏好排序，某个样本对在LLM看来仍可能具有高度的不确定性。在本文中，我们提出了多维偏好引导的在线直接偏好优化方法（MPG-DPO），它利用……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了多维偏好引导的在线直接偏好优化方法MPG-DPO，通过利用多维用户偏好数据来指导样本选择，解决了现有方法从LLM视角而非用户视角量化不确定性所导致的低效问题，实现了大语言模型对齐的样本高效个性化。
en_tdlr: Proposes MPG-DPO, a multidimensional preference-guided online direct preference optimization method that leverages multidimensional user preference data to resolve the mismatch between LLM-perceived and user-perceived uncertainty, enabling sample-efficient personalization of LLM alignment.
